g.title: The MlQube glue
g.text: Our thin layer of code (magenta) that turns open-source components (white boxes) into one platform · built on Crossplane

g.title: cluster_legend_frame
g.text: Someone asks for something in Backstage: a new tenant, a new ML project, a model in production
A glue template turns the form into a short YAML file and opens a pull request; a person reviews it
Merged: Argo CD applies the file, like everything else in the platform
Crossplane runs the glue's Composition: the file expands into every object it implies
The objects land in the open-source components and AWS; MLflow through a small glue function
Glue policies in Kyverno check every object: tenant label, names within the tenant prefix
Glue metering: the tenant label on everything → OpenCost → a cost report per business unit
